name: vwap_overshoot_fade_001
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index drifts 0.3%+ below (or above) session VWAP in a low-ADX tape, the move is driven by algorithmic momentum triggers and retail chase flow — not institutional directional conviction. RSI(24) (a 2-minute exhaustion read at 5s bars) hitting below 15 or above 85 signals that micro-momentum is fully spent and no new sellers/buyers are stepping in. VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks then begin rebalancing aggressively — fills at 0.3% from VWAP give them significant benchmark outperformance, creating strong buy/sell pressure back toward VWAP. The low ADX(36) filter (3-minute trend strength < 22) ensures no large TWAP/VWAP execution is underway, which would override the reversion tendency.
core_signal_oneliner: 0.3% VWAP deviation with 2-minute RSI at extreme exhaustion (<15/>85) in a low-ADX range-bound early session tape
